newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Meiya plans 80 mln B share IPO.
newsitem.headline: China's Meiya plans 80 mln B share IPO.

text.p: Chinese wool blanket maker Guangdong Meiya Co Ltd will launch an initial public offering (IPO) of 80 million hard currency B shares by the end of this month for listing in Shenzhen, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.

The firm would offer the shares at eight to nine times per-share net of about 0.45 yuan forecast for 1997 on a fully diluted basis, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.

Meiya, based in the southern province of Guangdong, has appointed Nomura International (HK) Ltd as the main international coordinator and Shenzhen J&A Securities Co Ltd as the chief domestic underwriter, the official said.
Meiya would use the proceeds to expand its wool blanket production, he said.
The company expected net profits for 1997 to reach 198 million yuan, compared with 158 million in 1996 and 146 million in 1995 based on Chinese accounting standards, he said.
Meiya, which produced about five million blankets last year and exported 30 percent of them, has a total of 342.94 million shares outstanding, the company said.
